title: IZEX NEXUS Community / Live Adapter
description: Portable evidence-aware infrastructure, business and local AI observability by Kingsley Izex / IZEX Solutions. Requires the documented read-only adapter and optional Prometheus metrics.

options.content:
**LIVE ADAPTER EDITION.** Select your Infinity and Prometheus datasources above; set Adapter URL to your fixed read-only endpoint. Configure the same origin in Infinity allowedHosts. Optional bearer auth belongs in datasource settings, never dashboard variables. Missing or stale data stays unknown. 

**IZEX NEXUS · Kingsley Izex / IZEX Solutions · MIT source.** Five configurable servers; up to24checks; declared dependencies; normalized AI activity; archive evidence. This is a community dashboard, not a vendor plugin or certification. Install/runbook/schema are included in the release package. Latest-value instruments ignore the historical time picker; history panels follow it. Resize for your display.

targets.expr: izex_ai_jobs{status=~"queued|processing"} and on() ((up{job="${ai_job}"} == 1) and on() (time()-izex_ai_snapshot_timestamp_seconds >= 0) and on() (time()-izex_ai_snapshot_timestamp_seconds < 120))

options.content:
**Grey / — means UNKNOWN, not zero.** Snapshot≤120s, complete source, host/check samples≤180s, no future clocks. CPU visual bands: <75% teal, 75–89.9% amber, ≥90% rose; display colors do not configure alerts. Dependencies are declared relationships, never measured traffic or proven causality.

Linux RAM can be total−available; hypervisor memory differs from guest pressure. Pools, VM filesystems and shared volumes overlap: never sum them. Expected401 can pass; public checks do not prove private transactions. Archive/checksum evidence is not a restore test. AI outcomes are rolling retained-record gauges, not counters. Job completion and source citations do not prove semantic correctness.

The bundled adapter does not create alerts, repairs, backups or an incident feed. Its incident count stays unknown unless you supply an explicit incident projection in your own compatible adapter. Optional Prometheus history panels require the documented metrics. No live service or private network needs to be made public to publish this dashboard.
